sanskrit: śarīraṃ yena jānanti na te yogyāḥ kulāgameyoganālaṃ samutpannaṃ trailokye sa carācaretacca kandeti paryāyaṃ tacca brahmabilaṃ smṛtamp. 194a) tayormadhye sthitā nāḍī suṣumṇā madhyamā smṛtātasya *? labilaṃ kandaṃ nābhyūrdhvādhoṅgulaṃ smṛtamtasya madhye sthitā śaktiḥ pañcakāraṇabhakṣiṇībhāvānābhāvagamyā sāprayātā parame padetatra sthitvātmano rūpaṃ prākṛtaṃ tu parityajetyaṃ prāpya tarate pāraṃ ghorāt saṃsārasāgarātkuṇḍalīkṛti vikhyātamudayāstagakāraṇamphaṇapañcakasaṃyuktā vāmāvartā trivartulāūrdhvādhaḥ kramayogena yā śivāntaṃ śivolvanātripañcāṅgulavistārāmitavarṇā kulāraṇīnānāvidhāni cihnāni paśyati svapnavat priyepadmarāgasamākāramādityasamatejasamhṛdayaṃ tad vijānīyād viśvasyāyatanaṃ mahataṣṭāṅgulapramāṇena lambamānamadhomukhamtatrābhyāsagato yogī paśyatyātmānamātmanāsaṅghataṃ sarvanāḍīnāṃ hṛdayaṃ tadudāhṛtamīśatsudhāra savaraṃ śaśinaśca pītvā tatkṣuttṛṣāṃ maraṇadāharujāṃ nivṛttiḥvyomātītaṃ paraṃśāntamātmarūpaṃ vyavasthitampañcavarṇadharaṃ devaṃ pañcakālasamāyutamniṣprapañcaṃ nirābhāsamaṅguṣṭhaikapramāṇakamp. 196a) candrakānti samaprakhyaṃ cintayetkalayā yutamtatra vai daṇḍapāṇistu saṃsthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00261 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ādvijātyanvyajātyantamekādṛ *? va rūpiṇīpramāṇarūparahitaṃ bhāvagamyaṃ sadoditamśivena saha caikatra viśrāntiṃ kurute sadāsā hyeva gulphajānuha sarvādhāre layaṃ gatāḥturyakoṇā tu janmākhye tataḥ skandasya bhāminitadvai sañjīvanasthānaṃ bhūtānāṃ jīvasaṃpuṭesparśāśca lalanāmūle lālākhyāllambake tathāitye te ṣodasādhārāssaṃsthitāḥ kulamadhyataḥhṛdayātkaṇṭhasaṃsthānaṃ viṣṇusthānaṃ prakīrtitamkaṇṭhā tu yāvadbhrūmadhyaṃ rudrasthānaṃ tu tadviduḥbindau tu yāvattalvantamīśvarākhyamanukramamtālvantād dvādaśāntaṃ tu sthānaṃ sadāśivaṃ sthitamp. 199b) ṣaṣṭhambā samāyuktaṃ svacchadaṃ vigatā mayamdīrghasvarasamāyuktaṃ haṃsaṃ haṃsāṅgabhūṣitamvyāpinī sahitaṃ devaṃ sṛṣṭikṛdvyāpinīśvarammantrātītaṃ paraṃ śāntamunmanyantaṃ nirāmayammatijñanaikagamyaṃ tamitareṣāmagocaramśivaṃ sarvagataṃ śūnyaṃ sa bāhyābhyantare sthitamrāśicakragataṃ devamayanadvayasaṃsthitampakṣadvayasamāyuktaṃ sarvabhūteṣvavasthitamṣaṭpathaṃ ṣaṭpathātītaṃ śūnyaṃ ṣaṭkasamanvitamṣaṭpathaṃ ṣaḍabhāvākhyaṃ citpatiṃ cetanātmakamkūlā * * *? lādhāramakulaṃ kulanā * *? myaṃ sarvasvamiti prāhustaṃ vande parameśvarama * * * * * ktiśca tasmai pūrṇātmane namaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00261 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣāḍguṇyaguṇasaṃyuktā tasmai vyāptātmane namaḥkṣayotpatti na yasyasthastasmai nityātmane namaḥna śabdo na tathākāśastasmai śūnyātmane namaḥp. 241a) akarṇaḥ śṛṇute yaśca tasmai cittrātmane namaḥviśvaṃ kāraṇanirhīnastasmai sraṣṭātmane namaḥtathaiva kartā yo nityaṃ tasmaikartrātmane namaḥsthairya rūpaṃ samāsādya tasmai sthityātmane namaḥsaṃharetkevalātmā ca tasmai kālātmane namaḥsaṃhṛtyedaṃ punaścaikaṃ tasmai māyātmane namaḥp. 241b) līlayā bhrāmyate yena tasmai vīrātmane namaḥbrahmāṇḍaṃ ca tathā yasya tasmai sthūlātmane namaḥyasyamānamidaṃ proktaṃ tasmai sūkṣmātmane namaḥsatvapañjaranirmāṇaṃ tasmai kṣettrātmane namaḥyaḥ śucirnirmalohaṃsastasmai kṣe?trātmane namaḥp. 242a) yaṃ jñātvā na punarjanma tasmai jñānātmane namaḥyāvatsarvagatā tṛptistasmai jñānātmane namaḥcitprakāśo hṛdivyāpī tasmaijīvātmane namaḥtayoḥ saṃkrīḍate yaśca tasmaihaṃsātmane namaḥśuklakarmarato nityaṃ tasmai śuklātmane namaḥkrūrakarmarato nityaṃ? tasmai kṛṣṇātmane namaḥyastejastapate nityaṃ tasmai sūryātmane namaḥāpyāyana karo nityaṃ tasmai somātmane namaḥpitṝṇāṃ pitṛsthānena tasmai vahnyātmane namaḥiḍāpiṅgalayormadhye saṃlīno hṛdayāntareyatpuṇyaṃ havyakavyena tasmai tīrthātmane namaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00261 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yaḥ śreyaḥ sarvakāryāṇāṃ tasmai lagnātmane namaḥp. 243a) citsūryagrahaṇaṃ yatra tasmai sthānātmane namaḥprāṇāpānakṣayo yatra tasmai mantrātmane namaḥpūjyate yogibhi yaśca tasmai pūjyātmane namaḥdehānte mokṣado yaśca tasmai japyātmane namaḥyatra mantro hakārākhyastasmai hotātmane namaḥyaścāntaḥ ṣaḍrasāhārastasmai bhoktātmane namaḥsa bāhyābhyantaraṃ sarvaṃ tasmai bhāsātmane namaḥbhūtākāśaṃ parityajya tasmai vyomātmane namaḥpaśyanti jyotiṣāṃ jyotistasmai yogātmane namaḥrecake yo vasedrudrastasmai prāṇātmane namaḥrudratve saṃharatyeva tasmai sthityātmane namaḥp. 244a) manunātrā yate yena tasmai mantrātmane namaḥanāhata paraḥ śāntastasmai varṇātmane namaḥdharmādharma mayaiḥ paśaistasmai vandhātmane namaḥsarvākhyeyaṃ paraṃśāntaṃ tasmai mokṣātmane namaḥlīyante sarva tatvāni tasmai liṅgātmane namaḥvyāpinyā sakalaṃ yaśca tasmai muktyātmane namaḥmāyāṃbāddhāsthito yaśca tasmai sarvātmane namaḥajñānatimirāndhasya unmīlanakaraṃ smṛtamparaṃ śuddhaṃ pavitraṃ ca sarvaduḥkhanivāraṇamsarvapāpaviśuddhātmā sa gacchecchā śvataṃ padam
